logp.method_description: The octanol-water partition coefficients were determined by the shake-flask technique: each ruthenium complex (at 0.1 mM) was dissolved in the water phase and an equal volume of n-octanol was added. The two phases were mutually saturated by shaking overnight at ambient temperature and then were allowed to separate on standing. The concentration of the metal complex in each phase was determined spectrophotometrically at lambda = 450 nm.
